query: SELECT timestamp, index1 AS repo, blob1 AS metric, blob2 AS outcome, blob3 AS leader, double1 AS round_size, double2 AS presubmit_runs, double3 AS presubmit_runs_saved, double4 AS bisect_steps, double5 AS landed, double6 AS culprits, double7 AS conflicts, double8 AS round FROM weft_land_preview ORDER BY timestamp FORMAT JSON
